title.ko: 토론: rebuttal · concede · grant · be that as it may · notwithstanding · on balance
title.en: debate: rebuttal, concede, grant, be that as it may, notwithstanding, on balance

explain.ko: 토론에서 양보(concession)와 반박(rebuttal)은 함께 쓰일 때 효과적입니다. I concede that ..., Granted that ..., Be that as it may, ..., Notwithstanding ... 같은 표현으로 상대의 타당한 점을 인정한 뒤 약점을 짚으면 신뢰를 얻습니다. 마지막에는 On balance, ...로 종합적인 판단을 제시합니다. 좋은 토론은 상대를 이기기보다 논점을 명확히 하는 것입니다.
explain.en: In debate, concession and rebuttal work well together. Expressions such as I concede that ..., Granted that ..., Be that as it may, ... and Notwithstanding ... let you acknowledge the opponent's valid points before pointing out weaknesses, which wins trust. At the end, On balance, ... presents an overall judgement. A good debate is about clarifying the points rather than defeating the opponent.
